name: nonmath-mc-v1
note: Non-mathematical multiple-choice bank for E13 discriminant validity (history, literature, philosophy, law, linguistics, geography, art, non-quantitative biology). Single unambiguous answer, exact-letter machine grading (no LLM judge). Chosen to span easy->hard so the weak->frontier model range spreads, mirroring AIME/IGS coverage. Answers are well-established facts.

questions.question: The Peace of Westphalia (1648) ended which conflict?

choices.C: The War of the Spanish Succession
